name: oxlint-plugin-guardrails
description: Oxlint rules that enforce readable TypeScript, bundled with the anti-slop rules and a recommended config.

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:skill-assets && pnpm check:rule-tests && pnpm check:anti-slop && pnpm check:examples
scripts.demo: oxlint -c examples/oxlint.config.ts examples/before.ts; oxlint -c examples/oxlint.config.ts examples/after.ts
